t: Could LLM-assisted Small World Theory In Search Disrupt Google?
s: Small-world theory proposes real-time web navigation for search, bypassing Google's traditional crawl-and-index model. This dynamic approach leverages the web's interconnectedness for fresher results and potentially more distributed infrastructure.
sub: Small-world networks and their application to web link graphs.
Comparison of real-time navigation vs. pre-indexed search models.
Advantages of small-world search for data freshness and decentralization.
LLM-assisted crawling for targeted information discovery.
